decisions.reason: The comfort insole is a low-cost accessory that complements shoe sales and the firm's foot-measurement services, so keeping it costs little.
The supportive insole meets ergonomic needs in the workwear market and is cheap to keep in the range alongside the other insoles.
The ergonomic safety shoe series has its own web page and belongs to the growing core segment the firm is emphasizing.
Firefighter and rescue boots need costly certification and have long product cycles, which makes an early withdrawal unlikely.
The moulded insole is the firm's flagship focus shown on the home page, so management will keep backing it.
